# Nested patterns and fallback reconstruction

These fourteen unchanged originals come from [pinned Bend flatten tests](https://github.com/bendlang/bend/tree/e6676b080f25b1bc1bf5b5b7d7a17e22f8022599/tests/flatten):
`nested_multi_scrutinee_000` through `_003`, `nested_ctor_000` through `_004`,
and `default_rebuild_000` through `_004`.
Copyright 2026 HigherOrderCO; Apache-2.0. See NOTICE and
`licenses/Apache-2.0.txt`.

Their function-valued mains qualify checking and exact normalized core/text.
Unchanged originals omit Base; separate authored probes add Base and prefix
local names to verify the C/JS function-printer refusal. No compiled execution
is claimed for these originals.

`applications.tsv` records 476 direct pinned interpreter application vectors,
observed twice. It covers five Nat depths, all BitPair/Color/Flag field choices,
and Nat lists of lengths zero through three with elements at those five depths.
The regression applies the same checked definitions and compares exact core/text.
Finite vectors are bounded evidence, not exhaustive equivalence for Nat or List.
